title: Basic Hits - 6-Day
description: Progressive training for JKD essentials: 22 Punches and 18 Kicks. Master them in manageable groups of 6.

days.notes: PUNCHES 1-6: Jab, Cross, Body Hooks, and Uppercuts. Focus on straight line principle.
days.notes_fr: COUPS DE POING 1-6 : Jab, Cross, Body Hooks et Uppercuts. Concentrez-vous sur le principe de la ligne droite.

days.notes: PUNCHES 7-12: Lead/Rear Hooks, Body Jab/Cross, Swings. Learn to change levels.
days.notes_fr: COUPS DE POING 7-12 : Hooks avant/arrière, Body Jab/Cross, Swings. Apprenez à changer de niveau.

days.notes: PUNCHES 1-12: Full integration of the first 12 punches. Maintain balance during flow.
days.notes_fr: COUPS DE POING 1-12 : Intégration complète des 12 premiers coups. Maintenez l'équilibre pendant le flow.

days.notes: PUNCHES 13-18: OverHeads, Qua Chuies. Advanced angles and non-telegraphed entries.
days.notes_fr: COUPS DE POING 13-18 : OverHeads, Qua Chuies. Angles avancés et entrées sans anticipation.

days.notes: PUNCHES 1-18: Continuous integration. Your punches should be getting faster and more relaxed.
days.notes_fr: COUPS DE POING 1-18 : Intégration continue. Vos coups doivent devenir plus rapides et plus détendus.

days.notes: PUNCHES 19-22: Final set. Marteau strikes and Lead OverHeads. Finalize the 22 punches series.
days.notes_fr: COUPS DE POING 19-22 : Dernier groupe. Coups Marteau et Lead OverHeads. Finalisez la série des 22 coups de poing.

Author: Antoine Giniès
description_fr: Entraînement progressif des essentiels JKD : 22 coups de poing et 18 coups de pied. Maîtrisez-les par groupes de 6.
